description: walnut chocolate chip cookies 1 cup (226g) unsalted butter 2 1/2 cups (305g) ap flour 1 tsp (6g) baking soda 1/2 tsp (3g) salt 3/4 cup (150g) brown sugar 4 tbsp (50g) white sugar 2 eggs 2 tsp (8g) vanilla extract 1 1/2 cups (260g) chocolate 1 cup (100g) chopped walnuts *cream together the softened butter and sugars until smooth. then mix in the eggs and vanilla. in another bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt. add the dry to the wet and fold gently to mix. fold in the chocolate and walnuts. set in the fridge for at least an hour (i did 3hrs), and then scoop. bake at 350 for about 12-14 min :) #walnut #chocolate #cookies #recipe
transcript: First, chocolate. Butter. Walnuts. Chocolate. And now we add the chocolate and the walnuts. Now we're going to set the first for an hour. And now we bake for the diesel. And now we're going to set the second for an hour.
